question: When does jim propose to pam on the office?
text: Jim proposes to Pam in **“Weight Loss, Part 2” (Season 5, Episode 2)** of *The Office*. He pops the question in the rain at a gas station halfway between Scranton and New York. The two-part season premiere originally aired on September 25, 2008.
